title: Single-nucleus RNA-sequencing of meningiomas

publications.title: A clinically applicable integrative molecular classification of meningiomas.

needs_manual_review_reason: NEW RECORD (2026-07-11), found via an author/lab-based search (Nassiri F publication list), never previously found by keyword search since it is EGA-hosted (controlled access) rather than in GEO. This is single-nucleus RNA-seq data (10 samples) for the same Nassiri et al. 2021 Nature integrative-classification cohort already represented in this inventory via mng-utoronto-2021-genomic.json (cBioPortal: CNV/mutation/proteomics) and gse-180061-methylation.json (methylation). Prior to this session, no single-cell/single-nucleus modality existed anywhere in this inventory for this cohort. Verified directly via the EGA Metadata API: study EGAS00001004982 ('Integrative Molecular Classification of Meningiomas', exact title match to the published paper), dataset EGAD00001007677 ('Single-nucleus RNA-sequencing of meningiomas'), 10 samples, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, released 2001-01-01 placeholder date in the EGA record (not a real release date; treated as 'Not reported'). paired_multimodal.related_datasets links to the companion bulk RNA-seq record (egad00001007494-nassiri-rnaseq), the cBioPortal record, and the canonical methylation record; gse-180061-methylation.json's own paired_multimodal has been updated to reference back. Only public EGA study/dataset-level metadata was used; the controlled-access sequencing data itself was never accessed, per docs/scope.md's compliance guardrail. CROSS-LINK ADDED (2026-07-13): msv000086901-nassiri-proteomics.json (this paper's proteomics arm, MassIVE MSV000086901) added as a new record and cross-linked here. CORRESPONDING-AUTHOR CORRECTION (2026-08-04): field previously read 'Farshad Nassiri / Gelareh Zadeh'. Re-verified against the paper's own PMC full text (PMID 34433969, PMCID PMC11604310): the author-notes/corresp block explicitly states 'Correspondence should be addressed to: Gelareh Zadeh ... gelareh.zadeh@uhn.ca' and names no other corresponding author. Nassiri is a genuine co-author (in fact first author) but not the paper's designated corresponding author -- corrected to Zadeh alone.
